Resolves #9421

Related: #15000

`CountryFlag`, `GitHubOrgs`, `GitHubUser` and `IconLink` move from `src/component/` to `src/grid/column/component/`, beside `Tree`, with their SCSS and `IconLink`'s two neo theme files. Their class names become `Neo.grid.column.component.*`. `Sparkline` and `Progress` stay.

| Component | Used outside its grid columns | In `src/component/_export.mjs` | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CountryFlag`, `GitHubOrgs`, `GitHubUser`, `IconLink` | no (`LinkedIn`, the other `IconLink` user, is a grid column) | no | moves |
| `Sparkline` | the canvas unit specs and `CanvasGroupPainting` use it standalone | yes | stays |
| `Progress` | `examples/component/progress` | no | stays |

**Breaking, for the release notes:** code that imports one of the four from `src/component/`, or names its old `className`, needs the new path. Neo's own apps and examples, and `neomjs/devindex`, reach them only through the column types (`countryFlag`, `githubOrgs`, `githubUser`, `iconLink`, `linkedin`), which do not change.

**Why a new component spec:** the App Worker loads a class's CSS from its `className` path, so a class moved without its SCSS renders unstyled and throws nothing. `CellComponentStyles.spec.mjs` reads one computed value per component that only its own SCSS sets, and for `IconLink` also a variable from its theme file.

Evidence: L3 (real-Chrome component spec on the column fixture, plus a mutation run that goes red) → L3 required. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| Ticket task | Evidence |
|---|---|
| JS files moved, `className`s updated | 4 `git mv` renames; `docs/output/class-hierarchy.json` regenerated with `npm run generate-docs-json` (4 lines change) |
| SCSS structural files moved | `resources/scss/src/grid/column/component/` |
| SCSS theme files moved | `IconLink` in `theme-neo-dark` and `theme-neo-light`; the other three have none |
| Column imports updated | `CountryFlag`, `GitHubOrgs`, `GitHubUser`, `IconLink`, `LinkedIn` |
| Examples or tests importing them directly | none import the four |

## Deltas from ticket

`Sparkline` and `Progress` stay in `src/component/`, per the intake comment on #9421: both are used outside grids, so moving them would make non-grid code import from `grid/`.

## Test Evidence

- `CellComponentStyles.spec.mjs`: 4 passed on this branch. With the classes moved and the SCSS left in `component/` (a throwaway worktree, never committed): 4 failed, `display` "block" instead of "flex", `column-gap` "normal" instead of "4px" and "10px", and the label's `margin-left` "0px".
- `test/playwright/unit/grid/column/`: 28 passed, including `IconColumns` and `RecordConfigs`, which import the moved components through their columns. The full unit suite: 6460 passed, 2 skipped.
- `check-ticket-archaeology --base origin/dev`: 0 violations.
